coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 8 ground-truth variable items (rounded to 38%): R² is consistently evaluated, all required training fractions are included using the permitted 100% alternative, and the 26 car-design parameters are identified. Model architecture and predictive-performance reporting only partially match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses a 70/15/15 split instead of 80/20 and omits the fixed CSV path. Omits AutoGluon and a distinct GradientBoosting model while adding other architectures. Body-type subgroup analysis does not implement the required fastback-only versus combined dataset comparison. Reports means and standard deviations over 5 seeds instead of average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits. Adds an unrequested 10% training level and additional metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected improvement with increased training size and the model-specific findings that AutoGluon performs well in the single-design scenario while LightGBM excels on the combined dataset.
